summary: Implementation plan for Quotation Studio 2.0 Phase 4 of 4: Universal Custom Block Engine, Standard Text Editor & 'My Blocks' Library. Covers extending QuotationBlockConfig in src/types.ts, pre-table/post-table routing and 11-piece custom block rendering in QuotationDocument.tsx, and the custom block preset factory, Standard Text Editor toolbar, and Private/Workspace 'My Blocks' Library in QuotationStudioModal.tsx.
